# The ejected temporaries of defer f()?, errdefer and scope defer stay out of
# the way of a goto: upstream Go builds the ejected module, and it prints
# the same ok lines as the native build.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/goto_temps.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/goto_temps.out
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/goto_temps.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/gototempseject

go 1.27
